structure.unit: Commercial Code — Bank Deposits and Collections
Relationship Between Payor Bank and Its Customer

law.catch_line: Bank not obligated to pay check more than six months old
law.text: A bank is under no obligation to a customer having a checking account to pay a check, other than a certified check, which is presented more than six months after its date, but it may charge its customer's account for a payment made thereafter in good faith.
